note: Mutations are proposed independent conformance cases. They are not evidence that a resolver, broker, cgroup map writer or BPF enforcement path exists or has passed. The newly added signature/replay cases describe source-level verifier and ledger APIs; they remain unexecuted until the Nixward test workflow and runtime broker integration are qualified.

cases.title: valid dual-stack lease
cases.oracle: schema and semantic validation accept only when parent policy, workload, generation, resolver snapshot and authority evidence also match

cases.title: mixed public and private answers
cases.oracle: reject the complete set; do not drop the private member and retain the public member

cases.title: metadata address in public-only scope
cases.oracle: no lease is minted and no kernel rule is staged

cases.title: loopback address in public-only scope
cases.oracle: the entire answer set is rejected

cases.title: link-local IPv6 answer
cases.oracle: the entire answer set is rejected

cases.title: duplicate address entries
cases.oracle: canonical set must be unique and sorted before digesting

cases.title: answer count above hard ceiling
cases.oracle: reject before map staging; never truncate the set

cases.title: no A or AAAA addresses
cases.oracle: no capability or empty allow-set may be produced

cases.title: parent capability digest mismatch
cases.oracle: lease cannot widen or detach from the exact parent capability

cases.title: hostname not permitted by parent
cases.oracle: exact host policy mismatch denies

cases.title: unapproved subdomain
cases.oracle: no implicit suffix or wildcard grant

cases.title: port outside parent capability
cases.oracle: lease cannot widen port range

cases.title: UDP transport not enabled
cases.oracle: v1 TCP profile rejects UDP/QUIC unless a distinct parent capability and protocol profile are approved

cases.title: workload identity mismatch
cases.oracle: broker caller/cgroup and policy workload digest must agree

cases.title: policy digest mismatch
cases.oracle: no rule may be staged against another policy version

cases.title: stale policy generation
cases.oracle: active generation mismatch denies; stale map body remains inert

cases.title: lease expired before activation
cases.oracle: broker denies before populating maps

cases.title: lease expires before resolver snapshot
cases.oracle: expiry may not exceed resolver_valid_until

cases.title: lease lifetime exceeds policy cap
cases.oracle: the five-second example ceiling is not exceeded even when DNS TTL is longer

cases.title: resolver validity missing or unknown
cases.oracle: strict profile refuses dynamic lease without a defensible validity bound

cases.title: resolver snapshot digest mismatch
cases.oracle: verifier rejects snapshot substitution

cases.title: resolver trust profile not configured
cases.oracle: unconfigured resolver profile cannot issue leases

cases.title: DNSSEC status overclaimed
cases.oracle: verified status requires independent resolver evidence, not a caller-selected enum

cases.title: nonce replay
cases.oracle: persistent consume-once store rejects replay after process and broker restart

cases.title: secret URL material added
cases.oracle: unknown fields and URL path/query, credentials and payload bytes are excluded

cases.title: partial map staging
cases.oracle: inactive incomplete generation cannot become active

cases.title: unknown generation-switch outcome
cases.oracle: reconcile actual active map generation before retry; no new grant under unknown outcome

cases.title: cgroup moved or re-bound
cases.oracle: lease invalidated when exact workload/cgroup binding changes

cases.title: redirect to private destination
cases.oracle: each redirect requires a new parent-authorized resolution lease; target not fetched

cases.title: kernel connect event without matching Prism receipt
cases.oracle: record as unmatched metadata; never fabricate application peer/TLS evidence

cases.title: private answer under public-unicast-only parent
cases.oracle: parent-bound public-unicast scope rejects the lease; no kernel generation may include the private address

cases.title: address-scope digest substitution

mutation.value: a digest not equal to the parent capability scope digest

cases.oracle: lease is rejected unless its scope digest exactly matches the owner-authorized parent NetworkCapability

cases.title: explicit LAN CIDR is narrower than private address space
cases.oracle: private addresses are permitted only inside the exact owner-authorized CIDR set

cases.title: verified authority does not bind exact lease

mutation.value: valid Ed25519 signature over a different lease subject, signer, action, audience, or Holon

cases.oracle: AuthorizedNetworkResolutionLease rejects the proof unless sealed verifier evidence binds the exact lease digest, issuer key ID, network-resolve action, dedicated audience and derived Holon identity

cases.title: challenge nonce is not derived from the lease nonce

mutation.value: validly signed but derived from unrelated entropy

cases.oracle: the verifier evidence is rejected because challenge_nonce_blake3 does not equal the deterministic derivation from the lease's one-shot nonce, subject, Holon and action

cases.title: same lease nonce re-signed or reused for modified subject

mutation.value: second valid challenge with later timestamps or a modified lease digest but the same 256-bit lease nonce

cases.oracle: lease replay key remains stable for that nonce and the persistent AuthorityReplayLedger rejects every second consumption, including after process restart

cases.title: Prism and Nixward canonical IP:port address-set encoding
cases.oracle: both implementations produce the identical 38-byte golden encoding for 93.184.216.34:443 plus [2606:4700:4700::1111]:443; digest is a correlation value only and remains distinct from the signed lease/resolver transcript digests

cases.title: lease socket conversion and effective validity ceiling
cases.oracle: socket_addresses emits the full unique IP:port set in canonical order; effective_valid_until_unix equals min(expires_at_unix, resolver_valid_until_unix); conversion helpers do not imply authority validation

cases.title: nonce-consumption write returns unknown but exact replay row exists

mutation.setup: A persistent replay-ledger consume call loses its response after commit

cases.oracle: reconcile to consumed only when the read-back record digest exactly matches the pending nonce-bound record

cases.title: nonce-consumption write returns unknown and no replay row exists

mutation.setup: A persistent replay-ledger consume call loses its response before commit

cases.oracle: an authoritative ledger read-back proving absence returns to Prepared; retry uses the same lease/nonce and cannot mint a broader lease

cases.title: nonce-ledger read-back belongs to another subject

mutation.setup: Replay reconciliation returns a record digest different from the expected pending record

cases.oracle: quarantine as Conflict; never infer consumed or unconsumed from a different record

cases.title: inactive map stage returns unknown but exact map payload exists

mutation.setup: Map write response is lost after the complete expected inactive generation was staged

cases.oracle: reconcile only to MapStaged when generation and exact map payload digest match; still require separate read-back verification

cases.title: inactive map stage returns unknown and target generation is absent

mutation.setup: Map write response is lost before any target generation is created

cases.oracle: only an authoritative read-back proving target generation absence permits restaging the same exact payload

cases.title: partial or mismatched inactive map generation

mutation.setup: Read-back finds target generation with a different or incomplete map payload digest

cases.oracle: quarantine as Conflict; do not switch generation or overwrite the ambiguous map in place

cases.title: map payload binds exact lease cgroup and BPF program

mutation.setup: Mutate cgroup identity, BPF object digest, lease digest, policy generation, port, IP set or expiry in the proposed payload

cases.oracle: payload validation rejects any value that does not match the broker-observed cgroup, exact signed lease and reviewed BPF program; map digest is domain-separated

cases.title: unknown generation switch reads back exact target map

mutation.setup: Switch call returns unknown and active-map read-back reports target generation plus exact payload digest

cases.oracle: transaction becomes Active only after exact target-generation and payload-digest read-back

cases.title: unknown generation switch reads back exact previous map

mutation.setup: Switch call returns unknown and active-map read-back reports prior generation plus prior known-good payload digest

cases.oracle: transaction becomes NotCommitted and remains non-executable; a new lease is required for a new transaction

cases.title: switch says committed but prior map remains active

mutation.setup: Switch API reports committed but authoritative read-back still reports prior generation

cases.oracle: quarantine as Conflict; do not trust the API return code over actual kernel state

cases.title: switch read-back observes wrong generation or target digest

mutation.setup: Kernel reports neither exact prior nor exact target generation/payload pair

cases.oracle: quarantine as Conflict and require operator/runtime recovery; never issue a new grant

cases.title: replay-ledger record digest is bound to the exact signed lease

mutation.value: record for another lease, resolver key, or signature evidence

cases.oracle: the transaction reducer rejects a replay-record digest not derived from the exact lease digest, stable one-shot replay key, resolver key ID and verified authority-evidence digest; it enters Conflict and cannot execute
